m: The {Lifeguard} pops up through the {Trapdoor} of the {Museum} and freezes: a stuffed *tiger* has come alive and is licking its lips. Her *heart* drums so loudly the exhibits rattle. She sits on a bench, chin in hand, to **consider** her options, and the tiger sits beside her to **consider** its lunch.

The {Shepherd} tumbles through the {Trapdoor} into the {Boxing Ring} and lands on a heap of soft *soil*, right beside an upturned *pitchfork* that missed him by a whisker. The crowd gasps. He finds a four-leaf clover in the soil, a coin in his boot, and bows: the **luckiest**, most **lucky** man alive.

The {Juggler} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Dunes} hotel dividing *soil* into perfectly *even shares* for a hundred flowerpots. A gust tips one pot higher than the rest, and she shrieks, scoops, and levels it with a ruler until every pot is dead **even**. Even the sand dunes below rearrange themselves to be **even**.

The {Shepherd} runs a clearance sale on the {Rooftop} of the {Cat Café}, flinging *gold coins* of change while a grumpy *portrait* of the owner yells "Everything must go!" Cats carry off teapots, cushions, the counter itself. By sunset he has **sold off** the entire café, then **sells off** the roof he's standing on.

The {Jockey} gallops across the {Rooftop} of the {Lagoon} lighthouse and pins a giant *bullseye* to the wall. Archers shoot *gold coins* at it, and every hit makes it BONG the hour. It is now a **clock**: the whole lagoon checks the time by the jockey's **clock**, which strikes thirteen whenever someone misses.

The {Sheriff} climbs to the {Rooftop} of the {Beehive}, which is shaped like a tiny *temple*, and recites to the bees. A *small speech bubble* drifts from his mouth with each line, rhyming "honey" with "money". The bees hum along, buzz the chorus, and by dawn the whole hive is buzzing his **poem**, a sticky **poem** about sheriffs.

The {Tsar} sneaks up the {Staircase} of the {Hangar}, crown wobbling, and dives into a pot of tall *grass* to **hide**. Guards run past. Then he crawls into a steel *vault* and slams the door, whispering "you'll never find me." He **hides** so well that the planes take off without him.

The {Gardener} sprints down into the {Basement} of the {Mansion}, late for the tulips, wheelbarrow squeaking. A *runner* in a tracksuit vaults a *drying rack* of socks beside him, yelling "**Hurry**!" They race each other round the furnace, scattering laundry, and the gardener **hurries** so fast he arrives yesterday.

The {Juggler} drops through the {Trapdoor} onto the stage of the {Museum} mid-show, knives flying. A *house* made of cardboard collapses, a *standing knife* wobbles upright on the floorboards, and the audience roars, sure it's part of the **play**. The juggler bows, takes a curtain call, and stars in the **play** for forty years.

The {Pirate} bursts out of the {Trapdoor} of the {Cat Café}, parrot squawking, and demands entry. A cat at the door punches a tiny hole in a paper *ticket* and holds out its paw. No **ticket**, no catnip latte. The pirate hands over a treasure map instead, and the cat stamps it as a **ticket**.

The {Sailor} stumbles into the {Basement} of the {Casino}, where a rogue *employee* in a waistcoat is smashing slot machines. A *helping hand* reaches from the shadows to stop him, but too late: dice cracked, cards torn, roulette wheel dented. Everything the sailor touches gets **harmed**, and the manager screams about the **harm**.

The {Hunter} sits on the {Rooftop} of the {Pool}, aiming at nothing, when **suddenly** a *pennant* flaps loose and smacks him in the face. His *heart* leaps out of his chest and dives into the pool below. **Suddenly** everyone is swimming after a beating heart, and the hunter is hunting for himself.

The {Juggler} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Museum} clutching a *set square*, and starts measuring the new exhibit: a dinosaur egg. It's **huge**. It's bigger than the museum. Every time she measures, it grows again, until the set square is the size of a church and the egg is even more **huge**.

The {Pirate} pops up through the {Trapdoor} of the {Tower}, lights a *campfire* under a mysterious brown *parcel*, and runs. KABOOM! The parcel was a **cannon**. It fires the pirate's hat, his boots and his parrot over three counties, and the tower is now officially a **cannon** that points at the moon.

The {Juggler} climbs up through the {Trapdoor} of the {Youth Hostel} into an attic where a dusty *pole* props up a tired, faded *sun* made of cardboard. Everything is **old**: socks from 1902, a grandpa backpacker, biscuits fossilised in their tin. She juggles three **old** teapots and they crumble into dust mid-air.

The {Dentist} perches on the {Rooftop} of the {Swan Pond} boathouse, on a wobbly *podium* at the very **end** of the gutter. A green *sprout tip* pokes from a crack beside him. Swans queue for checkups along the gutter, but the dentist only treats whoever reaches the **end**, so they shove each other into the pond.

The {Tailor} slips through the {Trapdoor} of the {Mansion} and finds a *deep cave* under the floor. A *helping hand* holding a torch pokes out of the wall and points the way. She **explores** with a tape measure, measuring stalactites and bats, and **explores** so far she pops out in somebody's bathtub in Peru.

The {Hunter} bounds down the {Staircase} of the {Pool}, and huge *water drops* splash from his hat. A walrus with enormous *whiskers* sneezes, and the pool overflows, flooding the street, the park, the whole town. By morning there's a **lake** where the town was, and the walrus is mayor of the **lake**.

The {Lifeguard} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Pool} with a soggy *logbook* and a whistle. She **records** everything: each splash, each cannonball, each duck that sneaks a swim. When a swimmer sneezes she writes it down in ink. When the pool drains, she **records** that too, then writes "lifeguard drowned in paperwork".

The {Yogi} falls through the {Trapdoor} of the {Hut} and lands in a lotus pose on a giant **leaf**. A huge *mouth* in the wall blows, and the leaf takes off like a magic carpet, its veins forming a *cross*. The yogi meditates as they surf over rooftops, carried by one enormous green **leaf**.

The {Chef} throws open the {Rooftop} of the {Casino} and serves a cake labelled *springtime*. One bite and flowers burst from the roulette wheels, birds nest in the slot machines and the croupiers sneeze pollen. It is **spring**, and gamblers bet on which tulip opens first, because **spring** has come early.

The {Shepherd} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Stadium} and draws one long *slash* of green paint across the city. Wherever the paint touches, buildings sink and fields pop up: cows, haystacks, a muddy lane. The football fans find themselves in the **countryside**, mooing at the referee, deep in the **countryside**.

The {Firefighter} climbs out of the {Trapdoor} at the {Pool}, slips on a *hillside* of wet towels, and crashes into the *cashier*'s booth. When she stands up, the cashier is **attached** to her helmet by a hose, the till **attached** to the cashier, and a chain of swimmers glued behind. Now they all go to fires together.

The {Shepherd} stretches on the {Rooftop} of the {Beach} hut, opens his *mouth* wide and starts to **breathe in**. A *chaser* in a speedboat races round the bay trying to escape the suction, but the shepherd keeps **breathing in**: sand, seagulls, sunscreen, the whole sea, until the beach is just a puddle.

The {Yogi} sits cross-legged in the {Basement} of the {Museum}, an *offering* bowl in her lap. Visitors line up and she **gives** each one something: a mummy's sock, a dinosaur tooth, the Mona Lisa's eyebrow. The curators weep. She smiles and **gives** them the museum's front door too.

The {Lifeguard} shoots down a snow ramp on a single *ski* into the {Basement} of the {Beach} club, where a *small altar* glows with candles. She leaves a **gift** wrapped in seaweed on it, and the altar opens its own **gift** in return: a rubber duck that sings opera.

The {Gardener} wheels a barrow of *water drops* down the {Basement} of the {Hangar}, through a narrow *alley* of crates, and pours them out. The floor floods, tugboats chug in, cranes sprout like sunflowers, and fishermen yell. The hangar is now a **harbour**, and the gardener plants seaweed along the **harbour** wall.

The {Yogi} meditates in the {Basement} of the {Museum}, so calm that clouds form on the ceiling. Then the *rain* starts indoors: drops on the dinosaurs, puddles under the pharaohs. The yogi chants louder, the **rain** falls harder, and the curators hand out umbrellas while the paintings drip in the **rain**.

The {Yogi} sits on the {Front Step} of the {Spa}, eyes shut, when a vampire with one shiny *fang* pops out of a bush. Her *mouth* drops open: "**Ah**!" The vampire screams back, "**Ah**!" and they both sit there going "ah, ah, ah" like a broken car alarm until the spa staff bring cucumbers.

The {Baker} saws away in the {Basement} of the {Mansion}, slicing a whole *tree* into a single flat **board**. A tiny *rebel* with a red bandana keeps leaping onto the board and shouting slogans. The baker ignores him, rolls dough on the **board**, and bakes the rebel into a pizza by accident.

The {Tailor} strolls down the {Staircase} of the {Boxing Ring}, past a rickety *shed*, into a sunny **courtyard** where two boxers are fighting over a fountain. She measures the *courtyard*, pins the paving stones with chalk and sews a lawn into the **courtyard**, so the boxers have to fight in socks.

The {Firefighter} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Pool} to save a *woman* who is stuck with a giant *comb* tangled in her hair. Splashing, hosing, combing, the firefighter frees her. The grateful **woman** combs the firefighter's moustache in return, and a queue of every **woman** in town forms for a turn.

The {Gardener} lies on the {Rooftop} of the {Waiting Room}, using a *comb* to brush the clouds into neat rows, waiting for his pigeons to **return**. One by one they **return**, each carrying a lost thing: a sock, a key, the gardener's wife, who'd been missing since Tuesday.

The {Juggler} on the {Rooftop} of the {Boxing Ring} juggles glass **eyeballs** under the stars. One *eye* slips, rolls through the *moss* in the gutter and gets covered in green fluff. It blinks at her. Now every **eyeball** in the pile wants a moss coat, and they all stare at the juggler, very fashionably.

The {Firefighter} slides down the {Trapdoor} of the {Mansion} pole straight into a dining room, hose blazing, and accidentally washes a *side dish* off the table. A small furious *rebel* in a napkin leaps up and declares war. They sign a truce over a **meal**, and the firefighter cooks the whole **meal** with her hose.

The {Ghost} floats up the {Staircase} of the {Hut} and bumps its **forehead** on the ceiling: BONK. A *guest* in pyjamas hands it a cold *page* from a newspaper to press on the bump. The ghost sticks the page to its **forehead** and reads the news upside down all night.

The {Hunter} sits on the {Staircase} of the {Mansion} with a whole gobstopper in his *mouth*, cheeks bulging. A grandfather *clock* booms each minute he survives. Rules: **keep it in the mouth**, no chewing, no swallowing. The butler bets against him, but the hunter **keeps it in the mouth** for a week and wins the house.

The {Sheriff} falls through the {Trapdoor} of the {Casino} into an underground *river*, clutching a single *page* of the rulebook. He can't swim against it, so he **follows** the current past roulette tables and floating poker chips. The page reads "**follow** the river," so he does, all the way to the sea.

The {Sheriff} rides a *cart* across the {Rooftop} of the {Pool}, racing a cowboy in a *dugout canoe*. The canoe slides down the slide, splashes into the pool and zooms ahead. The sheriff's cart crashes into a chimney. He **loses**, loses his hat, his boots, his badge: he **loses** everything except his moustache.

The {Yogi} on the {Staircase} of the {Tower} stops mid-pose because a giant *helping hand* reaches through the window and **shakes** the whole building like a snow globe. Stairs wobble, bricks rattle, the yogi bounces from floor to floor, calmly chanting, until the hand **shakes** her out of the window like a crumb.

The {Jockey} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Tower} beside a *town crier* ringing a bell and bellowing "Wanted! Riders! Brave ones!" A *helping hand* swoops down and plucks volunteers off the street. The jockey **recruits** grannies, toddlers and a confused horse, and keeps **recruiting** until the tower is full of jockeys.

The {Hunter} kneels on the {Rooftop} of the {Casino} at *twilight* before a *woman* in a sequinned dress, holding out a ring he won at blackjack. She says yes, the slot machines all hit jackpot at once and fireworks burst. It's a **marriage**, and every gambler in the casino throws chips at the **marriage** like confetti.

The {Tailor} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Warehouse} under a full *moon*, while a shifty *money changer* offers coins for her clothes. She **takes off** her hat, then her scarf, then her jacket, haggling for each one. The moon blushes. By dawn she's **taken off** her shoes and sold them too.

The {Baker} sits in the {Basement} of the {Pool} trying to **patch** a torn *shirt* with dough. A *fortune stick* pokes out of the hole, reading "more dough". He **patches** the shirt with pastry, the shirt with croissants, and soon the shirt is a loaf, which he wears proudly to the pool.

The {Wizard} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Lake} house, opens his mouth and a *small speech bubble* floats out. A hungry *stomach* growls back at him. "What do you **say**?" he asks it. The stomach **says** "pancakes", and the wizard spends three days trying to translate the gurgles into a spell.

The {Dentist} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Pool} with one giant *eye* glued to a telescope, **supervising** the swimmers. Her fat *uncle* sits beside her with a whistle. Every time a swimmer forgets to floss, the eye blinks red and the uncle blows. She **supervises** so strictly that the ducks floss too.

The {Dentist} creeps up the {Staircase} of the {Pool}, holding a green *seedling top* that smokes and fizzles. A furious *mother* snatches it from him and shrieks "**Poison**!" The leaf drips on the stairs and dissolves them. The mother chases the dentist round the pool waving a sign saying **POISON** in big letters.

The {Yogi} slips on the {Staircase} of the {Boathouse}, which drips with black *water drops* from a *sprouting field* of oil wells growing on the roof. She slides down the stairs, out the door, across the pier and into the river, leaving a rainbow slick of **oil**, still in perfect lotus pose, gleaming with **oil**.

The {Lifeguard} sprints up the {Staircase} of the {Cat Café} with a *swaddled baby* that has a terrible fever. She lays it on a *sickbed* of kittens, and the kittens purr until the fever melts away. The baby is **cured**, and the café now **cures** sniffles for the price of a latte.

The {Lifeguard} climbs down into the {Basement} of the {Museum}, finds a dusty *square* of carpet and sits on it. It shoots off like a magic rug. She **travels** through Egypt, the Ice Age, a medieval castle and back to the gift shop, still in her swimsuit, and asks to **travel** again.

The {Zookeeper} waddles down the {Staircase} of the {Hut} carrying buckets of *water drops* for a thirsty hippo. She trips, the buckets fly, and the floor floods into a muddy **pond** full of frogs and lilies. The hippo sighs happily and sinks in, and the zookeeper has to row across the **pond** to reach the kettle.

The {Tsar} storms down the {Staircase} of the {Island} palace with an axe, chopping every *tree* into planks of building **material**. A cheeky *green shoot* springs back up behind him each time. He stacks wood, bamboo and coconut shells into a mountain of **material**, then builds himself a throne that sprouts leaves.

The {Magician} vanishes through the {Trapdoor} of the {Yeti Cave}, where a yeti is roasting marshmallows over a roaring *campfire*. With a flourish, she slams a wooden *plank* down on the flames: whump. Fire **put out**. The yeti weeps a snowy tear, and she **puts out** his candles too, just to be thorough.

The {Jockey} gallops down the {Staircase} of the {Pool} on horseback, **chasing** a greased *pig* that squeals across the tiles. They thunder along the *road* outside, through a market, round a roundabout. The pig dives into the deep end, the horse follows, and the jockey keeps **chasing** it underwater.

The {Magician} pops up through the {Trapdoor} of the {Fort} at *sunset* waving a big sign that says **DO NOT**. Do not touch the cannon. Do not feed the guards. Do not open the trapdoor. A soldier opens it anyway and a hundred rabbits pour out, all holding tiny signs saying "**do not**".

The {Baker} sits in the {Basement} of the {Beach} shack, dipping a long *bamboo* stick tipped with *fur* into a pot of chocolate. It's a **writing brush**! He paints love letters on the cakes, poems on the baguettes, and when a cat walks by, he uses the cat as a spare **writing brush**.

The {Wizard} trudges up the {Staircase} of the {Hangar} with a wobbly *tombstone* strapped to his back. "Not yet," he tells it. The tombstone sighs, "everyone has **to die** sometime." They argue all the way up, until the wizard sneezes, the tombstone falls on a plane, and the plane pretends **to die** dramatically.

The {Shepherd} on the {Rooftop} of the {Yen Exchange} trades coins for a flapping *fish* and a freshly shorn *sheep*. Both are so **fresh** they sparkle: the fish winks, the sheep smells of daisies. Bankers queue to sniff them, and the shepherd puts up a sign: "**Fresh** air, one yen a breath."

The {Tsar} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Beehive}, where a bossy *boss* bee pops a *small speech bubble* over each worker. Every bubble holds a single **word**: "buzz", "honey", "faster". The tsar collects them in a jar, and when he opens it at dinner, each **word** flies out and stings a guest.

The {Sheriff} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Jungle} temple and lands at the feet of a glowing *saint* sitting under a palm. The **sage** strokes his beard and answers every question before it's asked. The sheriff tries to arrest him for being too wise, and the **sage** gently arrests the sheriff instead.

The {Zookeeper} on the {Staircase} of the {Hut} faces a hundred animals all begging for one banana. A giant *helping hand* lowers from the ceiling and lets her **choose**: monkey? giraffe? ant? She dithers for hours, and finally **chooses** to eat the banana herself while the animals boo.

The {Shepherd} crawls down the {Staircase} of the {Dunes} palace, combing the sand with a huge *comb*, **searching** for a lost sheep. He licks his *thumb* to test the wind. He finds a teapot, a camel, a buried car and a pharaoh's sock, and keeps **searching** while the sheep snores on the roof.

The {Chef} marches into the {Basement} of the {Hangar}, which is carved into a *cliff*, and flips a giant switch. Conveyor belts roar, robots whisk eggs, pancakes fly from chimneys by the thousand. The hangar is now a pancake **factory**, and the chef is its only worker, running the whole **factory** in a hairnet.

The {Sheriff} climbs through the {Trapdoor} of the {Waiting Room} and finds a *weeping willow* growing among the chairs. He lies beneath it, closes one *eye*, then the other, and falls **asleep**. The willow snores. The patients snore. By lunchtime the whole waiting room is **sleeping**, and the doctor is too.

The {Baker} stomps up the {Staircase} of the {Fort} holding a royal *proclamation* sealed with a *cross*, announcing an **extensive** bake-off. It lists every bread in history, from Roman rolls to moon bagels. The list is so **extensive** it unrolls down the stairs, out the gate and across three kingdoms.

The {Lifeguard} swings through the {Trapdoor} of the {Hut} on a runaway horse, gripping a strip of *rawhide*. With one *strong arm* she hauls back hard to **rein in** the beast, and it skids to a stop on its bottom. Then she **reins in** a runaway cow, a goat and a startled grandpa on a bicycle.

The {Yogi} meditates on the {Rooftop} of the {Mansion} on a straw *sleeping mat*, right next to a crackling *campfire*. **Smoke** curls up and forms shapes: a dragon, a teapot, a giant nose. The yogi doesn't open her eyes, but the neighbours call the fire brigade, who find only **smoke** doing yoga.

The {Sheriff} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Boathouse} to **teach** rowing. A *helping hand* passes oars down the line in a tidy *handover*, rower to rower. The sheriff **teaches** them to row backwards, sideways and in circles, and by sunset the boat is spinning like a top.

The {Ninja} drops silently through the {Trapdoor} of the {Warehouse} and meets his own *lookalike*. A *small speech bubble* pops up between them: "I **promise** I'm the real one." They both **promise**, pinky-swear, and shake hands, then can't remember which one made the first promise.

The {Lifeguard} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Casino}, where a *standing person* sorts gamblers into a *neat stack* by family: cousins here, grandmas there, in-laws in a sulky pile. She whistles at anyone arguing. It's a lesson in **human relations**, and the casino now charges entry for **human relations** therapy.

The {Ghost} slides down the {Trapdoor} of the {Mansion} into a hidden sea. It paddles toward a *mountain* rising from the waves and finally reaches the *shore*. Sandcastles, shells, a lifeguard chair. The ghost builds a sandghost on the **shore** and sunbathes, invisible, on the **shore** all afternoon.

The {Ghost} drifts through the {Trapdoor} of the {Tower} into a *maze* of twisting corridors that rearrange themselves when nobody looks. Even the ghost gets lost. Strange music plays, doors open onto clouds. It's deeply **mysterious**, and the ghost leaves a note: "this tower is too **mysterious** even for me."

The {Tailor} skips up the {Staircase} of the {Hangar} carrying a sack of *sugar* and sprinkles it over a jumbo jet. The plane turns into a silk-sailed ship from the **Tang dynasty**, with poets, horses and emperors waving from the windows. She tailors them all new robes, very **Tang dynasty**, with sugar sequins.

The {Magician} springs up through the {Trapdoor} of the {Island} beach and sets up a *market stall*. He **sells** coconuts that turn into rabbits, sunglasses that see tomorrow, and bottles of sea air. Tourists stampede. By lunch he has **sold** the whole island, including the beach he is standing on.

The {Ghost} glides up the {Staircase} of the {Hut} and finds a *standing person* in a fur hat sharing tea with a fierce *spearman*. Snow piles at the window, a samovar bubbles and balalaika music plays. The hut has teleported to **Russia**, and the ghost learns Cossack dancing in **Russia** till morning.

The {Jockey} gallops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Spa} and knocks a *jack-in-the-box* into a *campfire*. It hisses, it fizzes, it **explodes**: BOING-BOOM! Bubble bath sprays the ceiling, cucumber slices rain down, and the jockey's horse is blown into a mud bath. Even the towels **explode** into fluff.

The {Zookeeper} drives a wooden *cart* up through the {Trapdoor} of the {Island} zoo, a knight's *lance* strapped on top. The cart **carries** a giraffe, three penguins and an angry tortoise. It's so overloaded that the wheels squeal, but she **carries** on, the lance poking every coconut off the trees.

The {Lifeguard} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Warehouse} and finds a whole river rushing between the shelves: the **Luo River**. She sits on the *riverbank* with her whistle, and boxes float past like boats. She yells "no running beside the **Luo River**!" at a crate that ignores her completely.

The {Juggler} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Yen Exchange} into a gym where a *builder* is lifting a *standing person* over his head like a dumbbell. They do push-ups on coins and sprints round the vault. Everyone's cheeks glow; they're horribly **healthy**. Even the coins become **healthy** and start jogging.

The {Tailor} sweeps up the {Staircase} of the {Hangar} into a *main hall* with a ceiling so high clouds float under it. She unrolls a carpet the length of a runway and the echo repeats her every sneeze nine times. A thousand guests dine in the **hall**, and the tailor sews curtains for the whole **hall**.

The {Pirate} thumps up the {Staircase} of the {Hangar} and parks his ship on the *roadside* outside. He refuses to stand in the middle of anything, ever; he always shuffles to the **side**. The planes pass him on one **side**, the parrot on the other, and the pirate tiptoes sideways like a crab.

The {Gardener} climbs onto the {Rooftop} of the {Lagoon} villa and stacks a golden *roof* on top of it, then another, held up by a huge stone *spine*. Fountains, peacocks and crowns sprout everywhere. It becomes a **palace**, and the gardener rules the **palace** with a hose instead of a sceptre.

The {Hunter} sits on the {Rooftop} of the {Hut} with a giant jug of lemonade. A *question mark* floats from his *mouth*: thirsty? He **drinks** it all, then the rain barrel, then the pond, then the rain as it falls. The clouds dry up, and the hunter keeps **drinking** with a hiccup.

The {Juggler} slides through the {Trapdoor} of the {Yeti Cave}. A *standing person* is drying *sun-dried meat* on a washing line. "Can I **borrow** some?" she asks, juggling it before he answers. She **borrows** the meat, the line, his hat and the yeti, promising to bring them back next Tuesday.

The {Juggler} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Dunes} palace, crowning a stern *lord* with a sand-castle crown. Instantly he becomes **monarch** of the desert. Camels bow, scorpions salute, and the wind spells his name. The juggler juggles the royal jewels, and the **monarch** demands she juggle him too.

The {Juggler} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Inn} into a *forbidden grove* where every tree wears a red sign: **forbidden**. No juggling, no singing, no laughing. She juggles anyway. The trees gasp, the signs flash, and a strict owl **forbids** her from ever coming back, while secretly clapping its wings.

The {Yogi} sits on the {Rooftop} of the {Inn} meditating in the *shade* of one enormous grey cloud. The sky is **overcast**, gloomy and drizzly, but the yogi refuses to move. More clouds pile up, the whole town goes dim, and the guests eat breakfast by candlelight, complaining it's **overcast** indoors too.

The {Yogi} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Mint}, drops a *yuan coin* into the soil and a whole **garden** springs up overnight: roses, tomatoes, money trees. She builds a little white *fence* around it, but coins keep sprouting through the fence, and bank robbers sneak into the **garden** to pick them.

The {Magician} sneaks down the {Staircase} of the {Boathouse} with a basket of *plum* fruit and a *small speech bubble* whispering secrets. They **plan** a heist: swap every boat for a plum. Maps, diagrams, codes. The **plan** is perfect until the magician eats all the plums before midnight.

The {Sailor} pops up through the {Trapdoor} of the {Lagoon} hut into a scroll painting: a tiled *roof*, a gnarled pine *tree*, and scholars sipping tea in the **Song dynasty**. They hand him a brush and teach him to paint mist. He stays so long he gets a job in the **Song dynasty** navy.

The {Baker} pops up through the {Trapdoor} of the {Beach} café and spots a *pioneer* in a coonskin cap stomping down the *road* to sell him wagon wheels. The baker **avoids** him: ducks behind a sandcastle, rolls under a towel, hides in a croissant. The pioneer looks everywhere, and the baker **avoids** him for a decade.

The {Jockey} on the {Rooftop} of the {Water Park} reaches out a *helping hand* while a giant eagle swoops with one *talon* outstretched. They both **grab** the last rubber ring. Tug-of-war! The eagle wins, so the jockey **grabs** the eagle, and they fly down the slides together.

The {Robot} marches up the {Staircase} of the {Lagoon}, where crowds throw *grass* garlands at him like confetti. He has just won the world's toaster championship. Trumpets blare and medals clank on his chest. He basks in the **glory**, beeping proudly, and his batteries glow gold with **glory**.

The {Gardener} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Pool} with his **aunt**, a fierce *woman* who collects *antique* swimsuits. She models one from 1890 with frills and a bonnet and cannonballs off the roof. Splash! Everyone claps for his **aunt**, who climbs out and changes into an even older antique.

The {Sailor} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Casino} rocking a tiny *grandson* in his arms. The baby grabs the dice and rolls a double six every time. The casino panics. Gamblers line up to touch his little toes for luck, and the sailor's **grandson** wins the casino before he can say "**grandson**".

The {Tailor} sprints down the {Staircase} of the {Tower} with a *cracked shell* of an egg on her head and a dragon hatchling behind her. She bursts out onto the *road* and **escapes** on a bicycle, the baby dragon chasing. They both **escape** into the forest, and the tower guards don't even notice.

The {Yogi} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Spa} and finds a vampire lying in a mud bath, one *fang* aching. She ties a string to the **tooth** and the other end to the door. SLAM! The **tooth** flies across the spa and lands in someone's cucumber water, and the vampire whimpers happily.

The {Sheriff} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Pool} and lands on a *bundle* of floating pool noodles. She lassos them, ties them with rope and **binds** them tight into one huge raft. Then she **binds** the swimmers to it too, so nobody can drift away, and they all bob around grumbling.

The {Tailor} bounces through the {Trapdoor} of the {Cat Café} on a pogo stick, *kicking foot* first, and lands on an egg. A *cracked shell* pops open and out leaps a kitten that **jumps** onto her head. Cats everywhere start **jumping**: off tables, out of cups, onto the chandelier.

The {Dentist} climbs out of the {Basement} of the {Boxing Ring} with a hammer and a giant *nail*, pinning a single *page* to the very **top** of the corner post. It reads: "Floss!" Boxers climb after her to read it, stacking on each other's shoulders, and the dentist bows from the **top** of the pile.

The {Yogi} rises through the {Trapdoor} of the {Museum} balancing a glowing green *jade gem* on her nose. Guards chase her, but every time they touch the **jade** they turn calm and start stretching. Soon the whole museum is doing yoga around the stone, and the director swaps the Mona Lisa for more **jade**.

The {Jockey} crashes through the {Trapdoor} into the {Funfair}, where riders are screaming on a runaway rollercoaster. She tosses *gold coins* to the crowd and holds up a huge *magnifying glass* that makes everything look tiny and silly. Everyone giggles and **calms** down. Even the rollercoaster sighs, **calmed**, and parks itself.

The {Shepherd} wanders into the {Basement} of the {Ice Rink}, where the *rain* is freezing mid-air. He drags a giant *comb* through the clouds and flakes tumble out: **snow**! It piles up to the ceiling, and the sheep bounce in it, building a snowman wearing his hat, then a whole **snow** family.

The {Wizard} sits in the {Basement} of the {Pool} grinding a *pestle* in a mortar, waiting for exactly **noon**. The moment the clock strikes twelve, the pestle sings, sunlight shoots through a pipe and every swimmer's shadow disappears. At **noon** sharp the wizard eats lunch, his only spell of the day.

The {Lifeguard} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Yen Exchange} with a spool of *silk thread* and **practises** knots. Reef knot, bowline, granny knot, a thousand times. She ties the bankers to their chairs by accident. "Sorry, still **practising**!" she shouts, and ties the vault door to the moon.

The {Pirate} springs up through the {Trapdoor} of the {Fort} and **forces** a terrified *white dove* down the *road* at cutlass-point. "Deliver my ransom note!" The dove refuses, so he **forces** it into a cannon and fires it over the walls. It lands on the king's breakfast, note and all.

The {Yogi} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Hut}, where her **grandpa** sits in a rocking chair telling stories about her *father* as a baby. He does a headstand to prove he's still flexible, then a cartwheel, then a backflip. **Grandpa** lands in the soup and declares it a perfect landing.

The {Pirate} lies on the {Rooftop} of the {Yen Exchange}, scribbling on strips of *bamboo* and nailing them under a *nameboard* with his title. It's a **piece of writing** about buried coins, so thrilling that bankers climb ladders to read it. The wind steals one strip, and the whole city chases the **piece of writing** down the street.

The {Robot} clanks through the {Trapdoor} of the {Boathouse} carrying a giant slab of *meat* on his shoulder, dripping and wobbling. He tries to use it as a paddle. The **meat** floats! He rows across the lake on a raft of sausages, and seagulls dive at him, screaming for **meat**.

The {Zookeeper} opens the {Basement} of the {Waiting Room}, where a pelican with a gigantic *beak* sits next to a toddler's wide open *mouth*. Who can open the biggest **mouth**? The pelican swallows a chair. The toddler swallows a sandwich whole. The zookeeper gasps, and her own **mouth** is the biggest of all.

The {Gardener} wheels a cart into the {Basement} of the {Swan Pond} pavilion, where a stern *official* in a top hat guards a tiny *side dish* of peas. He declares the pea a national treasure and builds a whole **building** around it: columns, staircases, ticket desk. Swans queue to visit the **building**.

The {Baker} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Yen Exchange} and runs a lap of the *road* round the bank, reading the *nameboard* on every door aloud. Then another **time**. And another. Each **time** round he adds a loaf to the pile, and by the hundredth **time** the bank is buried in bread.

The {Firefighter} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Mansion} expecting dragons and gold, but finds only a plain white *sail* draped over a chair. It's totally **ordinary**: no ghosts, no treasure, just dust. She is so bored she hoses the sail into a boat, but even that floats in an **ordinary** way.

The {Chef} digs into the {Basement} of the {Pool} and pushes a giant *stone* under a *double mountain* of whipped cream. The pool, the diving boards and the snack bar all wobble on top. Without that **foundation** everything would slide away. He calls it a cake with a solid **foundation** and serves it.

The {Dentist} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Lagoon} jetty and finds a **hole** in the sea. *Water drops* trickle into it like a drain. She tries to plug it with a *matching cup*, but the cup falls through too. Now there's a cup-shaped **hole**, and fish swim down it waving goodbye.

The {Juggler} tumbles into the {Basement} of the {Mint}, where freshly printed money is drying on a giant *scroll* of paper. She starts to **roll up** the scroll, faster and faster, and rolls up the printer, the guards and herself inside. The mint finds a huge paper burrito and **rolls it up** further.

The {Tailor} kneels in the {Basement} of the {Mansion} at *sunrise*, ironing the *soil* with a giant iron until the lumpy floor is perfectly **flat**. Then she irons the stairs, the cat and the butler, all **flat** as pancakes. They slide under the door and go to work like paper dolls.

The {Ninja} creeps up the {Staircase} of the {Youth Hostel} and meets a huge *cow* wearing a backpack. Not a cow: an **ox**, with horns, booking a bunk bed. The ninja tries to sneak past, but the **ox** moos and sits on him, and the backpackers take selfies.

The {Ninja} tiptoes up the {Staircase} of the {Boxing Ring}, climbs a ladder under the *roof* and hammers one *nail* through a boxing glove. Now nobody can punch. The crowd stops yelling, the boxers have tea, birds sing. It's so **peaceful** that the ninja naps in the ring, very **peaceful**.

The {Jockey} rides into the {Basement} of the {Beehive}, where bees spin *silk thread* into thin sheets and write their *family tree* on each one. Stacks of **paper** rise to the ceiling. The jockey's horse eats one, sneezes, and the whole basement explodes in a snowstorm of **paper**.

The {Jockey} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Pool} doing a *headcount* of the swimmers below. **All** of them? She counts again, and again, and the number grows each time, until **all** the fish in the sea, all the ducks and all the clouds are in the pool, waving to be counted.

The {Shepherd} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Dunes} oasis, where a *river* runs between the sand hills. A *small speech bubble* hovers over his head shouting orders to his camels: sit, swim, roll over. He **trains** them until they can paddle down the river in formation, the best **trained** camels in the desert.

The {Sailor} sits on the {Rooftop} of the {Beehive} hugging a single golden *grain stalk*, elbowing bees away with one sharp *elbow*. "**Private**!" he yells. "My grain!" The bees buzz a protest. He puts up a sign, "**PRIVATE**: no buzzing", and the bees build a hive on the sign.

The {Jockey} gallops across the {Rooftop} of the {Swamp} cabin, and a whole *farmstead* sprouts from the mud: barns, ducks, haystacks, a church bell. Soon it's a **village**, with frogs as postmen and alligators running the bakery. The jockey becomes mayor of the **village** because she's the only one with boots.

The {Zookeeper} crawls into the {Basement} of the {Pool}, props a *stepladder* against a *small altar*, and climbs up to light candles for her **ancestor**, a famous hippo tamer. The candles flicker and a ghostly hippo rises, splashing. Every **ancestor** joins in, until the pool is full of ghost hippos doing laps.

The {Sailor} balances on the {Rooftop} of the {Beehive} across a narrow *plank*, while the bees spin shiny threads of **silk** around him. They wrap him from head to toe like a gift. He wobbles, falls, and dangles from the roof on a single strand of **silk**, swinging like a happy pendulum.

The {Firefighter} on the {Rooftop} of the {Mansion} slips on a pile of *feathers* and tumbles across a *footprint field* of muddy tracks. She keeps **turning over**, somersault after somersault, flipping roof tiles, chimneys, the weathervane. By the bottom the whole mansion has **turned over** and sits upside down.

The {Baker} bursts through the {Trapdoor} of the {Tower} during a scorching *heatwave*. Ovens explode, bread pops like popcorn, and a **violent** wind slams doors and rips the curtains. The baker wrestles a rogue baguette in a **violent** brawl, and they tumble down the tower together, crumbs everywhere.

The {Sailor} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Funfair} ferris wheel and plants a *tree*. Then another *tree*. Then a third *tree*. They multiply like popcorn until the dodgems are under ferns and owls run the ticket booth. The funfair has vanished into a **forest**, and the sailor sails a rowboat through the **forest**.

The {Tailor} scoops *soil* into the {Basement} of the {Spa} and stacks it higher and higher, each level with a tiny *thatch* roof. It pokes through the ceiling, then the clouds. It's a **pagoda**! Monks climb it, spa guests climb it, and the tailor sews bells to every floor of the **pagoda**.

The {Magician} slides through the {Trapdoor} of the {Fort}, covered in *soot*, with a *dog* who has swallowed his whistle. Not a sound. The soldiers stop shouting, the cannons stop booming. The magician waves his wand and the whole fort turns **silent**, even the birds, even the dog's wagging tail, perfectly **silent**.

The {Wizard} climbs through the {Trapdoor} of the {Fort}, and a giant *helping hand* reaches out of a tiny *cottage* to **grasp** him. It squeezes him like a lemon. He wriggles loose, but it **grasps** his wand, his beard, his hat, and won't let go until he shakes it politely.

The {Shepherd} pops through the {Trapdoor} onto a stage on the {Beach}, where a hero raises a *halberd* in his *right hand* and roars. The sheep play the villains, the seagulls play the orchestra. It's pure **drama**: tears, betrayals, a sheep wedding. The shepherd sobs through every act of the **drama**.

The {Yogi} creeps into the {Basement} of the {Inn} and slips into a crack in the *hillside* behind the wine barrels. Her *racing heart* thumps so loud it might give her away. She stays **hidden** for a week, and the innkeeper stays **hidden** from his taxes in the same crack.

The {Sheriff} sits on the {Staircase} of the {Pool} roasting peaches over glowing *embers* like a *roast*. They swell, soften and smell divine: perfectly **ripe**. The swimmers climb out dripping and line up. Every bite is so **ripe** that juice squirts across the pool and sticks to the ceiling.

The {Gardener} digs in the {Basement} of the {Pool} and unearths a giant *bone*. Then another. A whole dinosaur skeleton rises from the drain and climbs the ladder. The gardener feeds it a **bone**-shaped biscuit and it wags its tail, rattling every **bone**, and dives into the deep end.

The {Firefighter} climbs down to the {Basement} of the {Hangar} to **visit** her old friend, who lives in a chalk *square* on the floor. A *small speech bubble* pops up: "Come in!" She steps in, has tea, and **visits** every square in the hangar, one after another, until dawn.

The {Robot} clanks through the {Trapdoor} of the {Warehouse} and tries to lift a feather. He can't. His arms are **weak** as wet noodles and his batteries flicker. A mouse carries him home on its back, and the robot sighs, feeling so **weak** that even his beeps come out as tiny squeaks.

The {Magician} creeps up the {Staircase} of the {Jungle} temple and pulls out a giant *blindfold*. He uses it to **cover** a monkey's eyes, then a tiger's, then the sun. Darkness falls. He **covers** the whole jungle like a birdcage at night, and the parrots finally stop squawking.

The {Gardener} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Hut} with his *elder brother*, who lets out a huge *yawn* that turns into a tune. They sing a **song** about turnips so loudly the clouds dance. The neighbours join in with pots and pans, and the **song** goes on until the turnips sing too.

The {Dentist} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Yen Exchange} into a rickety *shed* where a *fortune teller* sells crystal balls. They open a **shop** together: toothpaste and prophecies. "Your future: fewer cavities." Customers flood the **shop**, and the dentist predicts every filling.

The {Gardener} sweeps the {Basement} of the {Waiting Room} and finds a *ghost* waiting for an appointment that ended in 1850. The **ghost** sighs, rattles a chain and asks for a magazine. The gardener plants a geranium in its lap. The **ghost** is so pleased it haunts the flowerbeds instead.

The {Robot} rolls a *cart* into the {Basement} of the {Swan Pond} pavilion, piled with feather pillows. He gives a huge *yawn* and flops onto them. Everything is **soft**: soft pillows, soft swans, soft marshmallow walls. His metal body melts into jelly, and he's too **soft** to stand up.

The {Dentist} sits in the {Basement} of the {Yen Exchange} behind velvet *curtains*, reading aloud from the great **canon** of tooth law. Each rule is a *song*, and bankers sing along: "floss before dawn". The **canon** is so long the dentist reads it to the vault, which hums every verse.

The {Yogi} bursts out of the {Trapdoor} of the {Museum} into a painted *valley* full of chocolate rivers. She gives a huge hungry *yawn*: **desire** sweeps over her. She wants everything: the cake, the fountain, the moon. Her **desire** grows so big that the museum guards hide the exhibits.

The {Sailor} pops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Spa} and finds a serene **Bodhisattva** sitting on a mat of fresh *grass*, glowing gold. Spa guests float around in bliss. The sailor offers him a cucumber slice, and the **Bodhisattva** smiles, blessing the bubble bath, which turns into lotus flowers.

The {Hunter} crouches in the {Basement} of the {Warehouse} beside a *campfire*, alone, until a *standing person* steps out of the shadows with sausages. Instant friends! They sing, swap stories and toast marshmallows. Now he has a **companion**, and the **companion** follows him everywhere, even into the bath.

The {Zookeeper} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Tower} when a feeding *trough* of mud tips over and slides down the *road* straight at her. Splat! She **suffers** a bath of mud, then a flock of pigeons, then a hailstorm. She **suffers** it all with a smile, and the pigs cheer.

The {Pirate} clomps up the {Staircase} of the {Mansion} with a little *boat* balanced on a big *dish*. He serves it at dinner: a **plate** with a ship sailing on gravy. Guests poke the sails with forks. Then he spins the **plate** like a frisbee, and it sails out the window.

The {Baker} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Spa} and finds a giant *python* wearing a *father*'s tie and slippers, reading the paper in a mud bath. "**Dad**?" The python nods, hisses a dad joke and wraps the baker in a hug. **Dad** always gives the longest hugs.
